body:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is section s13 of the-crew-does-its-own-bookkeeping, and the diff adds _log_location_findings at reckon/crew/reports.py:1555, wired into audit_manifest at reports.py:2824, which refuses a cited log that resolves outside the manifest's run directory.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks for a test refusing a scratch-dir citation and accepting a run-dir one, a negative control that removes the check, and a base/after suite delta; tests/test_every_log_a_manifest_cites_exists_under_the_run_directory.py:80-141 asserts the refusal and the acceptance, and expanded-negative-control.log records 19 failed / 2 passed after the check is removed.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares tests/test_every_log_a_manifest_cites_exists_under_the_run_directory.py, reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py, and the evidence fragment and figure paths; the diff touches reports.py, the new test, test_a_control_log_is_judged_at_write.py and the fragment, all inside that set.
VERDICT manifest: read; it reports 21 focused checks passing, 0 added failure ids on both the expanded suite and the 36-file importer set, a manifest audit returning ok=true, and every gate log under the run directory.
VERDICT diff: read all six commits from b4700c0d to 37df9713; four files and 252 insertions, the production change being 39 lines in reports.py (the helper plus two call-site lines and one _cited_log_paths addition).
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/reports.py:audit_manifest, reckon/crew_run_commands.py (the crew check --manifest path)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:2824 calls the new _log_location_findings inside audit_manifest, which is the refusal the section requires.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: expanded-after.log records 5 failed and 93 passed and expanded-comparison.json reports 0 added failure ids against b4700c0d, and the negative control at expanded-negative-control.log records 19 failed, though the base arm carries the same five pre-existing failures.
SCORE scope_discipline: 17
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/the-crew-does-its-own-bookkeeping/wave4-codex-the-crew-does-its-own-bo-s13.html is the only non-code file changed.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_every_log_a_manifest_cites_exists_under_the_run_directory.py:96 asserts a non-zero exit and :98 asserts the finding names the cited path, which reddens when the audit_manifest wiring at reports.py:2824 is removed, as the recorded control shows.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helper mirrors the finding-list shape of its neighbour _test_log_findings at reports.py:1589 and reuses the _NONE_VALUES convention at reports.py:3106.
SCORE reuse: 11
JUSTIFICATION reuse: _log_location_findings at reports.py:1569 re-implements containment that _resolves_under at reports.py:3111 already owns.
FINDING reckon/crew/reports.py:1569 non-blocking: containment is re-implemented with Path.resolve().is_relative_to instead of the module's own _resolves_under helper, so two notions of in-run-directory containment now exist and can drift.

findings.text: reckon/crew/reports.py:1569 non-blocking: _log_location_findings re-implements containment with Path.resolve().is_relative_to(root) while the same module already owns _resolves_under at reports.py:3111 (used at reports.py:3091); the addition duplicates rather than extends the owner.
